boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity UI DESIGN BOARD, not a marketing poster, for 杭电失物招领, a Hangzhou Dianzi University campus lost-and-found service. Chinese Simplified UI text must be clear and accurately typeset. Apple-inspired functional simplicity, PingFang SC / system typography, generous intentional spacing, off-white #F5F5F7 page, pure white cards, ink #1D1D1F, muted #6E6E73, accessible blue #0066CC primary actions, fine gray hairlines, restrained 12-16px continuous corners, very subtle shadows. Frosted material only on navigation or sheets, opaque readable content. SF-like clean line icons, no Apple logo, no copied Apple product branding. Every screen has purposeful information hierarchy and fully visible navigation/actions. No gradients, no giant hero, no decorative 3D objects. Use small realistic object thumbnails when relevant: silver headphones, dark umbrella, obscured campus card; no legible personal numbers in photographs. Shared name 杭电失物招领, shared fictional user 林同学. All posts require contact, contact appears in detail only. Only campus options 下沙校区、绍兴校区、文一校区. Navigation must be consistent across sheets. Clearly label every frame with requested ID and title OUTSIDE its UI. Keep dense content legible, do not replace required screens with arbitrary decorative components. This is static design only.
